<pr_description>
Consider the following PR description:
For a string with trailing spaces, freetype ignores the last space in boundary calculations
Originally reported by: **Lenard Lindstrom (Bitbucket: [llindstrom](https://bitbucket.org/llindstrom), GitHub: [llindstrom](https://github.com/llindstrom))**

----------------------------------------

For non-rotated horizontal text, a string of one space, " ", will produce a zero width rectangle or surface. A string of two spaces produces a rectangle or surface of only one space in
width.

Fix: include the advance of a terminating space of a string in the calculation of the text boundary. Normally only the bitmap width of the last character in a string is used when determining the text boundary. This avoids boundary padding, empty rows or columns. But a space is nothing but padding; its bitmap has width and height of zero. So make an exception for the trailing space and use its advance to extend the boundary.

An test for the bug will be included in the unit tests.

----------------------------------------
- Bitbucket: https://bitbucket.org/pygame/pygame/issue/243


</pr_description>

        FT_Vector_Unit(&unit, mode->rotation_angle);

        rotate.xy = -unit.y; /* -sin(angle) */
        rotate.yx = unit.y;  /*  sin(angle) */

static UpdateLevel_t
mode_compare(const FontRenderMode *a, const FontRenderMode *b)
{
    FT_UInt16 a_sflags = a->style;
    FT_UInt16 b_sflags = b->style;
    FT_UInt16 a_rflags = a->render_flags;
    FT_UInt16 b_rflags = b->render_flags;

    if (!same_sizes(&a->face_size, &b->face_size) ||
        a->rotation_angle != b->rotation_angle ||
        (a_sflags & GLYPH_STYLE_FLAGS) != (b_sflags & GLYPH_STYLE_FLAGS) ||
        (a_rflags & GLYPH_RENDER_FLAGS) != (b_rflags & GLYPH_RENDER_FLAGS) ||

        return UPDATE_LAYOUT;

}

same_transforms(const FT_Matrix *a, const FT_Matrix *b)

import pygame
import pygame.freetype as ft
import os

pygame.init()
ft.init()

# Use the default font
font = ft.Font(None, size=24)

# Test 1: Empty string
rect = font.get_rect("")
print(f"Empty string rect: {rect}, width: {rect.width}")

# Test 2: Single space
rect_one_space = font.get_rect(" ")
print(f"Single space ' ' rect: {rect_one_space}, width: {rect_one_space.width}")

# Test 3: Two spaces
rect_two_spaces = font.get_rect("  ")
print(f"Two spaces '  ' rect: {rect_two_spaces}, width: {rect_two_spaces.width}")

# Test 4: Three spaces
rect_three_spaces = font.get_rect("   ")
print(f"Three spaces '   ' rect: {rect_three_spaces}, width: {rect_three_spaces.width}")

# Test 5: "A " vs "A"
rect_a_space = font.get_rect("A ")
rect_a = font.get_rect("A")
print(f"'A ' rect: {rect_a_space}, width: {rect_a_space.width}")
print(f"'A' rect: {rect_a}, width: {rect_a.width}")
assert rect_a_space.width > rect_a.width, "Trailing space should increase width"

# Test 6: Leading spaces
rect_leading = font.get_rect(" A")
print(f"' A' rect: {rect_leading}, width: {rect_leading.width}")

# Test 7: Spaces in middle
rect_middle = font.get_rect("A B")
print(f"'A B' rect: {rect_middle}, width: {rect_middle.width}")

# Test 8: Multiple trailing spaces
rect_multi_trailing = font.get_rect("A  ")
print(f"'A  ' rect: {rect_multi_trailing}, width: {rect_multi_trailing.width}")

# Test 9: Space width consistency
space_width = font.get_rect(" ").width
two_spaces = font.get_rect("  ").width
assert two_spaces == space_width * 2, f"Two spaces should be double single space: {two_spaces} vs {space_width * 2}"
print(f"Space width consistency check passed: space_width={space_width}, two_spaces={two_spaces}")

# Test 10: Render test
surface_one = font.render(" ", fgcolor=(255,255,255), size=24)
print(f"Single space surface size: {surface_one[0].get_size()}")

surface_two = font.render("  ", fgcolor=(255,255,255), size=24)
print(f"Two spaces surface size: {surface_two[0].get_size()}")

# Test 11: Check that the advance is returned correctly
# The advance should be the pen position after rendering all characters
metrics = font.get_metrics(" ")
print(f"Single space metrics: {metrics}")

# Test 12: Check get_rect returns correct rect
# For "A B ", we expect width to include all characters including trailing space
rect_ab_space = font.get_rect("A B ")
print(f"'A B ' rect: {rect_ab_space}, width: {rect_ab_space.width}")

print("\nAll tests passed!")
EOF
python /testbed/test_space_bug_comprehensive.py"}

{
    FT_Pos min_x = text->min_x;

    FT_Pos min_y = text->min_y;
    FT_Pos max_y = text->max_y;

    *underline_top = 0;
    *underline_size = 0;
    if (mode->style & FT_STYLE_UNDERLINE) {
        FT_Fixed half_size = (text->underline_size + 1) / 2;
        FT_Fixed adjusted_pos;
        FT_Fixed uline_top;
        FT_Fixed uline_bottom;

        if (mode->underline_adjustment < 0) {
            adjusted_pos = FT_MulFix(text->ascender,
                                     mode->underline_adjustment);
        }
        else {
            adjusted_pos = FT_MulFix(text->underline_pos,
                                     mode->underline_adjustment);

        uline_top = adjusted_pos - half_size;
        uline_bottom = uline_top + text->underline_size;
        if (uline_bottom > max_y) {
            max_y = uline_bottom;
        }
        if (uline_top < min_y) {
            min_y = uline_top;
        }
        *underline_size = text->underline_size;
        *underline_top = uline_top;

    offset->y = -min_y;
